summary: Iteration 20 testing: Weekly Attendance Recap API, auto-archive+purge cycle, cron webhook, role gating, Excel neatness (Inventory, Dana Sosial, Weekly), and frontend recap page / student ID card layout. 12/12 backend tests passed. All frontend checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4000+ lines — consider splitting into routers (attendance, inventory, auth, etc.) for maintainability.
ATT_RECAP_ROLES=require_roles('kepsek','guru','staff_tu'); super_admin bypass is handled inside require_roles, which is correct but non-obvious. Consider documenting this.

attendance_archives documents embed the xlsx bytes as base64 in Mongo — for large schools (800 students * many weeks) this can grow unbounded. Consider external storage (filesystem or S3) with just a reference in Mongo.
_archive_week uses db.attendance.delete_many without a transaction after inserting the archive; a crash between insert and delete could leave duplicate data. Low risk but worth noting.
Cron webhook uses hmac.compare_digest correctly; dedup via cron_runs is good. Consider adding a TTL index on cron_runs to prevent unbounded growth.
test_credentials: tu.demo@sekolahku.id / Demo12345 ; siswa.demo@sekolahku.id / Demo12345 (nisn 0099887766); WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET from backend/.env
seed_data_creation: test_archive_now_cycle inserts a demo-scope attendance doc dated 2 weeks ago (prefix TEST_) directly into Mongo and cleans up both the doc and the resulting archive after the test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file /app/backend/tests/test_iter20_weekly_attendance.py covers: GET /attendance/week (default+custom start), /attendance/scan + week visibility, /attendance/week/export xlsx, archive-now full cycle with prior-week doc insertion and purge verification, cron webhook (auth/badsecret/missing-run-id/ok/duplicate), siswa 403 on archives endpoints, and Inventory + Dana Sosial xlsx neatness (title, column widths, summary labels fully visible). Weekly recap matrix uses marks keyed by YYYY-MM-DD with lowercase statuses (hadir/izin/sakit/alpa), not H/I/S/A letters.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. One minor test fix during authoring: initial draft assumed students[].marks was a list indexed by weekday and used H/I/S/A letters; actual API returns marks as a dict keyed by date string with lowercase status. Fixed in test file.

frontend_verified.siswa_card_qr_visible_top_right_wide_bar: Confirmed via screenshot (/app/.screenshots/card_siswa.png) — QR renders top-right, barcode wide across bottom with testid id-card-barcode (246px wide).
